sentences.text: Social worker Priya Nandra is conducting a review following Edna Hollis's fall in October.
Edna Hollis has a hip injury that causes stiffness in the mornings and limits mobility.
Edna Hollis uses a frame in the house for mobility support.
Edna Hollis does not go out without someone accompanying her.
Carers visit Edna Hollis in the morning and at teatime.
The morning carer is named Jade.
Jade helps Edna Hollis with medication and personal washing.
Teatime carers arrive quickly but are often in and out, which Edna describes as 'a bit quick sometimes'.
Edna's daughter Sandra shops for her once a week on a Saturday.
Sandra lives in Castleford and drives to visit Edna.
Edna's grandson Kyle visits most weeks.
Kyle brings Edna's newspapers and goes to the cash machine for her because she can't access the post office.
Kyle uses Edna's bank card to access money.
Edna gave Kyle her bank card number to make it easier.
Kyle takes out £50 per week from Edna's bank card for himself.
Edna does not want Kyle to be involved with police or legal action.
Edna wants her money to be her own and does not want it to be taken by Kyle.
Edna does not want the police involved in the matter involving Kyle and her money.
Edna did not agree to Kyle taking £50 per week; she did not consent to this arrangement.
Edna did not authorize Kyle to take £50 per week; the money was taken without her explicit consent.
Edna reported that Kyle took £400 from her purse three weeks ago, after a visit.
The £400 was in Edna's purse and was gone after Kyle visited.
Kyle said he was only borrowing the £400 and would repay it, stating it was not stealing from his grandmother.
Kyle has not repaid the £400 as of the date of the conversation.
Sandra told Edna that Kyle gambles on his phone using betting apps.
Edna has not personally seen Kyle gambling or accessed his phone to verify the gambling activity.
Sandra knows about the £400 incident in the purse but does not know about the weekly £50 withdrawals.
Edna does not believe Kyle has threatened or harmed her physically or emotionally.
The social worker will log a safeguarding concern due to money being taken by Kyle without consent.
The safeguarding concern will be logged with the team, not with the police.
